title: The How to Hear the Difference in Two Bells
youtube_title: The How to Hear the Difference in Two Bells | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Sora about how to hear the difference between two bells. Sora wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
